I’ll present a week‑by‑week structure (weeks numbered 1–12), weekly templates, and clear guidance for swapping when flow occurs.

How to use this plan
- Start date: 2026‑06‑01 (Week 1 begins 2026‑06‑01). The client’s cycle dates repeat every 28 days from last period 2026‑05‑01, so predicted future menses starts (approx): 2026‑05‑01, 2026‑05‑29, 2026‑06‑26, 2026‑07‑24, 2026‑08‑21. Flow days (debilitating) are days 1–3 of each cycle (e.g., 2026‑06‑26–28, 2026‑07‑24–26, etc.). Always verify actual start each month and swap sessions if needed.
- Weekly training: 4 strength sessions + 1 power/plyo + 1 HIIT + 3 aerobic sessions is the full plan. If time or recovery is limited, drop one aerobic session (preferably Cardio A or B) or make strength 3×/week. Prioritise strength; cardio is secondary.
- Flow‑day rule: On cycle days 1–3 (severe dysmenorrhea), do NOT do heavy lifts (>85% 1RM), no HIIT, no plyometrics/jumping, and avoid heavy Valsalva. Use the “Flow Day Modification” template included below.
- Auto‑regulate using RPE, readiness, and symptom report. If cramps increase, reduce intensity/volume and prioritize recovery.

Weekly structure (standard non‑flow week)
- Day 1 — Session A: Heavy Lower (squat focus)
- Day 2 — Cardio B (easy) + Mobility
- Day 3 — Session B: Heavy Upper (bench/press)
- Day 4 — HIIT session (non‑flow only) OR Low‑intensity alternative on flow
- Day 5 — Session C: Deadlift/Posterior volume
- Day 6 — Power/Plyo session (non‑flow only) OR Flow alternative
- Day 7 — Long aerobic (Cardio C) or Rest depending on fatigue

If you prefer the 4 strength days grouped Mon/Wed/Fri/Sat, shift cardio/HIIT/power accordingly — keep at least 48 hours between heavy lower and power/plyo.

Program phases
- Phase 1 (Weeks 1–4): Foundation & baseline mapping. Moderate loads, technique, aerobic base build.
- Phase 2 (Weeks 5–8): Strength intensification (heavier top loads, 3‑week wave culminating in singles/doubles up to ~90–92% on non‑flow days). Includes HIIT and power progression.
- Phase 3 (Weeks 9–12): Peak & consolidation with moderate-to-high intensity, then a deload in Week 12 and 1RM testing in Week 11 (on a non‑flow day) if the client is ready.
